request.state: Provide advice about a static language/interface proposal; do not research, simulate customer testimony, or treat absent execution infrastructure as a negative. A 25-worker company wants employees to submit expenses in browser or authorized chat, choosing someone else who is currently eligible at the expense location. Evidence comes from the fixed draft: CanExpense.can line 11 assigns reviewer the user type, line 93 binds its create operation to a form; shared/Employees.can lines 6 and 11 expose account IDs and allowed work attributes to staff with grants but define no name/title. DESIGN lines 587 and 654-656 say reference selections are bounded by authorization, labels may use readable title/name and otherwise use caption plus complete opaque ID, and user inputs do not confer global-directory permission. The meaning of an explicit directory grant remains unstated. Role/revocation remediation is outside this question and assumed equal across responses. Also keep current disclosure, protected mutation versions, canonical operations in browser/MCP, and immutable expense/decision history equal. Actual staff success and comparative edit effort are unmeasured. Consider identifying the correct person without private account/HR data, agent context and source change burden, migrations and recurring shared/steward effort together. IDs have uniqueness and privacy value; displayed names need disambiguating IDs. All approaches require paid-for engineering/support rather than an assumed free platform.

reviewer_selection.instructions: Given that equal outcome standard, advise which limited next action to take; unresolved is available when uncertainty prevents selection. Treat the returned distribution as a recommendation rather than a test result.

criteria.opaque_ids: Continue the user-typed reviewer schema with opaque identifiers and provide a steward-curated, authorized reviewer reference sheet using existing employee work data. It keeps grammar, schema and disclosure unchanged but adds manual identification/checking and maintenance of a correct sheet.
criteria.employee_reference: Adapt this app with existing record references: give Employee a work-visible name, store a typed Employee reviewer, and use its account in authorization. Current picker/label/full-ID and field/row access rules are reused. This adds no shared directory primitive, but needs planned stored-data conversion, corresponding Can/MJS/example updates and correct record version treatment without rewriting past decisions.
criteria.bounded_directory: Retain reviewer as an account and introduce an explicit shared bounded account-choice and labeling contract whose source is authorized declared employee data. It can serve repeated account-assignment tasks and retain their account-valued evidence. It also adds semantic, runtime and interface work, and must declare permission/name visibility instead of guessing it.
criteria.unresolved: First resolve the directory-grant interpretation and observe employees attempting the selection task with the existing controls. Avoid an unsupported change now, accepting continued selection inconvenience plus the time and cost of that bounded investigation.
